name: Talk Of The Tavern
description:
About This Game

Build your mercenary guild, survive the road, and outbid rival guild masters in this competitive co-op auto-battler roguelike. Recruit powerful mercenaries, make difficult decisions between battles, and stop at taverns along the journey to strengthen your guild before the king’s tournament.

Mercs wander into the tavern looking for work. Bid on the ones you want, fight rivals for the same hire, or take a short loan if you’re stretched. Build a roster of knights, thieves, priests, warlocks, and more, then level them up between fights.

Between taverns, pick your path and fight through the wilds. Forests crawl with orcs and beasts, the tundra brings undead and wolves, and the ashlands throw demons and fire at you. Waves get nastier as you go, so keep the roster sharp or the road eats you. Or skip the tournament and take Endless: same biomes, no finish line, just how far your guild can push.

Between days, the Consortium of Scrolls offers new powers for your guild. Stack dozens of scrolls for more damage, tougher mercs, sharper bidding, or weird synergies, and reshape the run as you go.

Survive the road and you’ll reach the King’s Tournament. Put your roster against rival guilds in a bracket of duels, and only one seat walks away as champion.

Features

  • Recruit mercenaries in lively taverns: bid, outbid, loan, and steal talent before rivals do

  • Build a roster from 10 hireable kits, from Squires and Knights to Thieves, Warlocks, and Bards

  • Survive the road across Forest, Tundra, and Ashlands, each with its own enemy cast

  • Face orcs, undead, beasts, demons, and tougher waves the farther you travel

  • Alter your build with the Consortium of Scrolls: dozens of combat, defense, economy, and synergy powers

  • Level up mercs, spend attributes, and reshape your company between fights

  • Clash with rival guilds on the road, then settle it in the King’s Tournament bracket

  • Go Endless if you’d rather skip the finale and see how far your guild can push

  • Play solo with bot seats or online with up to 7 friends; the road is never empty!

  • Softcore or Hardcore: pick how punishing the road should be
short_desc: A co-op autobattler roguelike where rival guilds journey toward the King’s castle, stopping at taverns to outbid each other for mercenaries and shape their builds with powerful scrolls. Survive the road and conquer the King’s Tournament.
